    private static int maxCuts(int[] a, int b) {
        int[] costs = new int[a.length];
        int len = 0;
        int evens = a[0] % 2 == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        int odds = a[0] % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0;
        int cuts = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i < a.length; i++) {
            int cost = Math.abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]);
            if (odds == evens && cost <= b) {
                evens = 0;
                odds = 0;
                costs[len++] = cost;
            }
            if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
                evens++;
            } else {
                odds++;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
            int value = costs[i];
            int j = i - 1;
            while (j >= 0 && costs[j] > value) {
                costs[j + 1] = costs[j];
                j--;
            }
            costs[j + 1] = value;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (b < costs[i]) {
                break;
            }
            cuts++;
            b -= costs[i];
        }
        return cuts;
    }
}

        int odds = x[0] % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0;
        int cuts = 0;

                evens = 0;

            if (remaining < cost) {
                break;
            }
            cuts++;
            remaining -= cost;

    private static int answer(int[] arr, int b) {
        PriorityQueue<Integer> costs = new PriorityQueue<>();
        int numsEven = arr[0] % 2 == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        int numsOdd = arr[0] % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0;

        for (int i = 1; i < arr.length; i++) {
            int cost = Math.abs(arr[i] - arr[i - 1]);
            if (numsOdd == numsEven && cost <= b) {

                numsEven = 0;
                costs.add(cost);

            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
                numsEven++;
            } else {
                numsOdd++;
            }
        }

        int cuts = 0;
        while (!costs.isEmpty() && costs.peek() <= b) {
            b -= costs.poll();
            cuts++;
        }
        return cuts;
    }
